'''Sangu Shrine''' (山宮神社, *Sangu Jinja*) is a Shinto shrine located at Shichikama, Shin'onsen, Mikata District, Hyōgo Prefecture. It was formerly classified as a Son-sha{{efn|Former shrine rank|lt=Son-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Village shrine|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=近代社格制度|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q712534}}. The main deity enshrined is Ōyamatsumi, with additional enshrinements of Izanagi, Izanami, Emperor ōjin, and Susanoo-no-Mikoto.

== Overview ==
The shrine is located atop a small forested hill near the source of the Shichikama Onsen. The exact founding date is unknown. Before the modern era, it was known as '''Sangami Gongen''' (山神権現). In 1868 (the first year of the Meiji era), it was renamed to its current title. In 1873 (Meiji 6), it was designated a village shrine and enshrined Hachiman and the local Placenta deity.

The shrine's main hall was rebuilt in 1444 (Bun'an 1, Muromachi period), but was destroyed in 1944 (Shōwa 19) due to a typhoon. The current structure was rebuilt after World War II.

== Festivals and Events ==
* Annual Festival: September 29<ref>{{Cite web|title=Festival Calendar - Sangu Shrine|url=https://www.kirinnomachi-japan-heritage.jp/jp/reisai/1059/|access-date=2022-12-19|publisher=Agency for Cultural Affairs}}</ref>

== Cultural Properties ==
* '''Shichikama Qilin dance Dance''' - Town-designated Intangible Folk Cultural Property (designated March 31, 1986)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Shichikama Kirin Shishi-mai|url=https://www.town.shinonsen.hyogo.jp/page/?mode=detail&page_id=8ab359199e3f3c495d46db6ceb3791ec|access-date=2022-12-19|publisher=Shin'onsen Town}}</ref>
* '''Sangu Shrine Sacred Forest''' (山宮神社社叢) - Town-designated Natural Monument (designated March 31, 1986), featuring ancient Castanopsis and Hinoki cypress trees, along with thick growths of Camellia japonica and Sakaki.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Sacred Forest of Shichikama Sangu Shrine|url=https://www.town.shinonsen.hyogo.jp/page/?mode=detail&page_id=b500773414376fa6bd4970ec294860e2|access-date=2022-12-19|publisher=Shin'onsen Town}}</ref>

== Access ==
* West Japan Railway Company (JR West) San'in Main Line: From Hamasaka Station, take the Zentan Bus bound for Q11563591, and get off at "Shichikama Onsen-guchi" bus stop. 5-minute walk.
* From Osaka or Kobe, take the Zentan Bus Zentan Bus to "Yumura Onsen," transfer to the bus for Hamasaka, and get off at "Shichikama Onsen-guchi." 5-minute walk.
